name: Investor / Self-Employed Work Permit

requirements.blocker_text: Self-employed applicant (submitting a cover letter, credentials, resume, and police record instead of an employer letter) or investor applying through JAMPRO (Jamaica Promotions Corporation), which provides priority-processing support and liaison with the Ministry of Labour and PICA.

outcome.duration_length: same duration structure as jm_work_permit.json (typically up to 12 months at a time, renewable)

sources.title: Ministry of Labour and Social Security (MLSS), Jamaica -- Work Permit Department: describes the self-employed/investor application track (cover letter, credentials, resume, police record in place of an employer letter), routed with JAMPRO facilitation
JAMPRO (Jamaica Promotions Corporation) -- investor services: priority processing support for key personnel, liaison with the Ministry of Labour and Immigration, compliance advisory

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Jamaica). STATUS: PUBLISHED -- both sources tier-1. IMPORTANT STRUCTURAL FINDING: this is NOT a defined-threshold investor category -- no minimum capital, investment amount, or job-creation number could be found on any government source. It is functionally a facilitation service layered on top of the ordinary self-employed work-permit process, with JAMPRO smoothing the process rather than granting status under separate legal criteria. CONFIRMED ABSENT, NOT A GAP: Jamaica has NO citizenship-by-investment program, unlike several other Caribbean nations (St Kitts and Nevis, Dominica, Antigua and Barbuda, Grenada, St Lucia) -- Jamaican citizenship is obtainable only via birth, descent, marriage/registration, or naturalisation; this was confirmed by the total absence of any CBI reference across PICA, JAMPRO, and dobusinessjamaica.com. ALSO DISCLOSED, NOT MODELED AS AN ACTIVE ROUTE: a genuinely new 'Investor/Economic Residency' program (a formal permanent-residence-for-investment category, NOT citizenship) is in DRAFT LEGISLATION as of mid-2026, first proposed by JAMPRO back in 2013/14 and still moving toward parliamentary submission after a decade of delay -- no investment threshold, job-creation requirement, or fee has been made public, and it is not yet law. This dataset does not build a route file for legislation that doesn't exist yet; revisit if it's enacted.
